reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: Went for one overnight stay. Check in took 20 minutes as they had no idea what they were doing. Then the bath was clogged and when we went down to ask them to fix it there was nobody there. Furthermore, we did not sleep until around 2am due to intermittent shouting from the corridor. Nobody would answer the phone at reception, once again nobody being there. We were then woken at 6:30am due to an alarm once again nobody answering at the reception desk. This alarm went on for around 1 hour on and off. When we tried to get our money back under the good night guarantee. They said that as we did not inform anyone then they cannot give us our money back. Yet there was nobody to inform. Their terms and conditions states that you only have to let them know within 3 days of your stay anyway so this should not be an issue. Yet they are so hard to contact it is so much hassle. Bear in mind we paid £200 for a standard room no breakfast I don’t think that the quality is anywhere near good enough.

reviews.title: Work Trip
reviews.text:
I didn't have a great experience at this hotel. 

I had to change rooms twice due to cleanliness issues. I found hairs in the bed, stains on the bed sheets and stains on the bathroom floor. This has put me off staying at this particular Premier Inn again.

That being said, the location of the hotel is great for exploring London and the breakfast was really nice.

reviews.title: Good night's sleep, usual standard of Premier Inn -
reviews.text: Was what we expected of Premier Inn stay, comfortable and good location.  No smiles from any of the staff.  Used the self service check in as no staff around, but this was between 5pm-6pm.  Room clean and comfortable.  Bathroom looking tired.  Would stay again as overall good stay

reviews.title: Hygiene.
reviews.text:
Lovely stay but unfortunately the bedding was dirty. Once I addressed this with staff they got the domestic team to give me fresh bedding to make the bed myself. 
This wouldn’t have been an issues if I was checking in at 10am but it was 3pm onwards.

reviews.title: A Convenient Stay
reviews.text: This is a fantastic location for transport links. Had read previous negative reviews of this hotel, but we thought it was up to standard. Appearance wise it may be a bit tired, but it was clean and had everything we needed. Bed was super comfy, and triple(?) glazing kept out the sound of the traffic. Really good couple of nights sleep.
